newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, ignoring Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, ignoring Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen remaining mixed in slow trading on Wednesday despite a record high closing on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
"Local players would still be dominating the market today. I don't think foreigners would re-enter the market despite a record close on Wall Street," one broker said.
Brokers said they expected trading to be slow due largely to a lack of strong domestic factors.
Brokers, however, said they expected fresh news to come from shareholders' meetings scheduled to be held on Wednesday.
Automobile conglomerate Astra, Bank Tiara Asia, retailer Ramayana and conglomerate Bakrie were among firms scheduled to hold shareholders' meetings on Wednesday.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 2.74 points, or 0.40 percent, to 689.77 points.
